findings.statement: Do not accept the complete compound claim as independently source-checked from this review. The Nepal technical paper and CASM relay were not accessible; generic global-reference wording does not independently verify orthometric/IHRS details.
findings.resolution: Obtain readable exact technical source material through an ordinary public route or supplied portable artifact, then issue a separately versioned supplemental review. Keep this review's checked components and failed-access rows.

findings.statement: 8,848.86 m is verified as an announced value. Decimal places are not proof of centimetre measurement accuracy or current invariant summit height; no numerical uncertainty was independently checked.
findings.resolution: Retain dated announcement/surface/datum qualifiers. Any uncertainty or current-height statement needs separate evidence.

findings.statement: Multiple official texts, a participating survey paper and participant interviews trace to the same joint campaign. Distinct descriptions and a relay are not independent measurement confirmations.
findings.resolution: Keep common campaign lineage explicit and avoid an independence count based on page totals.

search_and_limits: Targeted direct retrievals of every listed source family using author notes to resolve exact URLs, DOI discovery and source searches. Failed guessed/obsolete routes were not used as evidence. No exhaustive contrary-literature, summit-data, uncertainty-budget or historical-survey audit. Web-rendered text read; no new raw-source hashes or rendered-PDF inspection asserted. Chinese short phrases interpreted in context; no certified translation claimed.
